name: REAL sampler (WeightFerry)
plain: Euler with a look-ahead velocity at the next point; when mismatch is small it advances multiple steps using that velocity. If it stays at one step, the second call is reused as the next step's first call. Near the end it is plain Euler with no look-ahead.
math: z=x+Δσ·u. Tail (σ′<0.15 or fewer than min_k steps left): x=z, no look-ahead. Else w=v(z,σ′). r_loc=rel_mismatch(u,w). If r_loc≤q_loc: try skipping candidates k with r_seg=(s_ik/h)r_loc≤q_seg; x=z+Δ·w, b=None (b=w if carry_policy always). Else k*=1: x=z, reuse b=w.
label: from code

audit.note: Omits the tail path and overstates reuse. real_sampler.py:79-81: if σ′<0.15 or fewer than min_k steps remain, plain Euler with no look-ahead. Second call is reused only on the 1-step fallback, unless carry_policy='always' (line 132; default fallback_only).
